title: Wrong icon shown when launching same app twice via two different .desktop files that have different icons
line: An app started from a second desktop file with its own icon now gets its own task with that icon, while windows it opens later still join the app's usual task.
explanation: The task manager maps a window to a desktop file from the window's own metadata, app id first. Two desktop files that start the same program (Thunderbird with two profiles, a second launcher with other arguments and its own icon) give windows with the same app id, so both always mapped to the program's own desktop file, icon and task; nothing told the task manager which file was used. KIO already puts the launching desktop file's name in the xdg-activation token as its app id. Now KWin remembers that app id for each token and, for the window that uses the token as it is first shown, sends it to the task manager in a new plasma-window-management event (launch_app_id); libtaskmanager prefers that desktop file when it runs the same executable, isn't hidden (NoDisplay) and declares no StartupWMClass for another window.

commits.message:
plasma-window-management: add launch_app_id event

Windows of an application started from several desktop files share one
app_id, so a task manager can't tell which file each window came from.
The new event names the app id of the activation token the window used.

BUG: 475736

xdgactivation: tell the task manager which desktop file opened a window

When several desktop files start the same application, all its windows
share one app id. Remember the app id each activation token was created
with and send it in plasma-window-management for the window it shows.

BUG: 475736

libtaskmanager: use the desktop file a window was launched from

When two desktop files start the same program, its windows share an app
id, so they always got the program's own desktop file and icon. Now the
launch app id sent by KWin wins when it runs the same executable.

BUG: 475736

patches.diff:
From 16d5c8e2c3ad9a6f1ebc3a4a12e154e2f4c78c6d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 03:28:59 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] plasma-window-management: add launch_app_id event

Windows of an application started from several desktop files share one
app_id, so a task manager can't tell which file each window came from.
The new event names the app id of the activation token the window used.

BUG: 475736
---
 src/protocols/plasma-window-management.xml | 17 ++++++++++++++---
 1 file changed, 14 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/protocols/plasma-window-management.xml b/src/protocols/plasma-window-management.xml
index b5a5565..cad5fea 100644
--- a/src/protocols/plasma-window-management.xml
+++ b/src/protocols/plasma-window-management.xml
@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@
     SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.1-or-later
   ]]></copyright>
 
-  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_window_management" version="23">
+  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_window_management" version="24">
     <description summary="application windows management">
       This interface manages application windows.
       It provides requests to show and hide the desktop and emits
@@ -127,7 +127,7 @@
     </request>
   </interface>
 
-  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_window" version="23">
+  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_window" version="24">
     <description summary="interface to control application windows">
       Manages and control an application window.
 
@@ -431,6 +431,17 @@
       </description>
       <arg name="resource_class" type="string" summary="resource class"/>
     </event>
+
+    <event name="launch_app_id" since="24">
+      <description summary="app id of the launch that created the window">
+        This event will be sent when the window was activated as it was first
+        shown with an xdg_activation_v1 token that carries an app id, as set
+        by the launcher with xdg_activation_token_v1.set_app_id. It names the
+        desktop file the window was launched from, which can differ from the
+        app_id when several desktop files start the same application.
+      </description>
+      <arg name="app_id" type="string" summary="app id of the activation token"/>
+    </event>
   </interface>
 
   <interface name="org_kde_plasma_activation_feedback" version="1">
@@ -474,7 +485,7 @@
     </event>
   </interface>
 
-  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_stacking_order" version="23">
+  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_stacking_order" version="24">
     <description summary="helper object for sending the stacking order">
       When this object is created, the compositor sends a window event for
       each window in the stacking order, and afterwards sends the done event
--

With the fix: the game launcher became its own running task
Master: the Dolphin task holds both windows
With the fix: the second window is the 'Home Folder Browser' task
Master (sweep tester): Konsole started from a second 'My Special Terminal' file is grouped in Konsole's task
